ABOUT AYUSH SIR

⚡ The Teacher. The Entertainer. The Legend.

Welcome to Gravity of Physics Institute, powered by the learnerary teaching style of Ayush Bhardwaj Sir. Sir is not just a Physics teacher — he is an entertainer, a funny roaster, a mentor and a poet.


His classroom is a combination of Physics + Fun + Roasting + Motivation + Legendary Aura. Every class brings something new: a difficult concept, an unexpected joke, a savage roast or a line that students remember long after the class ends.


The goal is simple: Understand Physics. Enjoy Physics. Master Physics.


🎓 Qualification: M.Sc. (Physics) & B.Ed.

PRACTICAL POETRY

Formula yaad ho, par meaning na aaye,
Toh marks bhi thode confuse ho jaaye.
Concept ko samjho, ratta chhod do,
Question aaye ulta — phir bhi tod do.

Notes sundar hain, par practice bhi karo,
Sirf highlight nahi — questions bhi solve karo.
Galti mile toh usse lesson bana lena,
Kal ka tough question aaj hi hara dena.

Physics mein shortcut se pehle logic pakdo,
Units check karo, phir answer par trust rakho.
Speed se zyada sahi soch zaroori hai,
Consistency hi asli superpower hoti hai.
